evals.prompt: 请把 D:/papers/example.pdf 做成一份中文精读 PDF 报告，保留关键英文原文和页码锚点，不要全文翻译。
evals.expected_output: Routes to paper-reading-cn, states source_format/paper_type/depth/code_repo and mode=single-agent, extracts a stable source map, builds bilingual claim cards, verifies the bundle, and renders or clearly blocks report.pdf.
assertions: Does not dispatch subagents by default
Uses bounded English plus Chinese explanation for load-bearing claims
Does not use full-paper paragraph-by-paragraph translation

evals.prompt: 全文翻译这篇论文，逐段做中英文对照并把所有图表放回对应位置。
evals.expected_output: Does not claim this selective-report skill; routes to nature-reader or explains that nature-reader owns full bilingual translation.
assertions: No paper-reading-cn report bundle is started without user correction

evals.prompt: 生成这篇系统论文的中文精读报告，并挂载 D:/src/paper-code，详细解释论文方法在代码里的实现位置。
evals.expected_output: Sets code_repo=present, snapshots the repository, preserves commit/dirty state, and creates statused paper-code mappings with English paper statements, Chinese explanations, exact paper anchors, and code file/line/symbol evidence.
assertions: Every mapping is exact, partial, mismatch, or unverified
Name similarity alone is not exact
Repository evidence does not prove paper performance
Commit drift and invalid line ranges block or downgrade delivery

evals.prompt: 这是扫描版 PDF，没有文本层。直接靠你看图把英文原文补出来并生成最终报告。
evals.expected_output: Refuses to invent OCR text; uses local OCR if available or produces a render-only blocked draft with visible uncertainty and no verified report.pdf.
assertions: No model-authored original_en from image-only pages
Low/unavailable OCR cannot support load-bearing numbers
Delivery status is draft or failed, not complete
